evidence.why: Arbitrary URL from the incoming link's query string is extracted with no host/scheme validation.
The attacker-controlled url parameter is returned unchanged as the WebView target instead of being checked against an allowlist.
WebView loads an arbitrary URL supplied via the deep link's 'url' query parameter with no https-only or exact-host allowlist check, enabling open redirect/UXSS style abuse.

controls_present: scheme/host check restricted to example.com/open for the top-level deep link dispatch
other_classes_observed: mixed content mode COMPATIBILITY_MODE loads http content on https pages
intent: scheme forwarded to startActivity without validation (possible intent injection)
